paragraphs.text:
A chapter notes that the most bizarre case of “undead” occurred 
among French Legionnaires in North Africa. Outpost guards 
were found strangled with flecks of dead, scaly skin still sticking 
to their throats. 
To continue looking over the books, go to 41; or, return to the 
New York Public Library, go to 74.
